meaning:
A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.23.25; also called Shammoth at 1Ch.11.27;
Another name of sham.mah (שַׁמָּה "Shammah" H8048H)
§ Shammoth = "desolations"
the Harodite, one of the 30 of David's mighty warriors

elsewhere.note: Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite,
